text:
Olive: Quick capture from NovaClinical pilot review  finance says they cannot reconcile charges to product routes. They asked for a downloadable reconciliation CSV plus a short playbook on how we compute "unit_cost" so AP can validate. This is holding their rollout.

Harper: Can you paste their AP sample or format?

Olive: Uploaded to intake (link: internal). They want columns: external_customer_id, team_tag, iso_dt, route_tag, request_id, tokens, model, unit_cost_usd, line_total_usd, invoice_ref.

Diego: Two paths: (1) Backfill a reconciled CSV from logs for the pilot (fast), (2) Add a real-time per-request export + normalized route_tag at ingestion (durable). Backfill estimate 48-72h; infra change 5-8d.

Mina: Also flagged a meta-ask: CS wants a simple way to weight product asks by renewal risk + ARR exposure so Product can prioritize finance-impact items. Suggest adding fields "renewal_risk" (low/med/high) and "arr_impact" (estimate USD) to intake.

Harper: Triage: Reconciliation CSV = P0 (renewal risk), weighting fields = P1 (process change), ingestion-normalization = P1/P2 (depends on scope).

SignalBot: Ticket created -> NC-404: "NovaClinical reconciliation CSV + intake-weighting" attached to intake doc.

Diego: Prototype CSV header for the backfill: 
```
external_customer_id,team_tag,iso_dt,route_tag,request_id,tokens,model,unit_cost_usd,line_total_usd,invoice_ref
```

Olive: NovaClinical agreed to a backfill as interim if we include a checksum and a short reconciliation checklist.

Mina: I'll update the intake template to include renewals and ARR estimate fields and attach a short guidance doc on how CS should score renewal_risk.

Harper: Action items:
- Diego: complete 48-72h backfill + upload CSV to intake (due 72h)
- Mina: update intake template with weighting fields + guidance (due 48h)
- Olive: coordinate NovaClinical finance validation session (schedule after CSV delivery)
- Diego/Mina: decide if ingestion normalization needs follow-up ticket after backfill

Diego: Starting the backfill spike tonight. Will post blockers.

SignalBot: Reminder scheduled -> follow-up NC-404 in 4 days.

Olive: Thanks all  I'll include this thread in the weekly CS->Product rollup and mark the account health as "at-risk" until CSV delivered.
